title: A status entry has Staff, Date and Time and can be searched
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active part, part A, for this test, so its Part History already holds its creation entries.
  • Start on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.
custom_steps:
1. Click the part A row.
  2. Click Inactive under Part Status.
  3. Click Save.
  4. Click Deactivate in the confirmation.
  5. Click the Inactive tab.
  6. Click the clock icon (Part History) at the left of the part A row.
  7. Type deactivated in the Part History search.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens.

Step 2:

  • Inactive is picked.

Step 3:

  • The confirmation opens.

Step 4:

  • Part A leaves the Active tab.

Step 5:

  • Part A is listed on the Inactive tab.

Step 6:

  • The "Deactivated" entry fills Staff, Date and Time like every other entry on the page.

Step 7:

  • The "Deactivated" entry is listed, and the creation entries are not.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change)

  • S10-R20: “A Part History entry keeps the Staff, Date and Time columns of every other entry, and can be found with the Part History search.”
  • S10-R27: “The Part History search finds an entry when the typed text appears in its Event text as shown on screen, or in its Staff name. Upper and lower case do not matter. This applies to every kind of entry.”
